adjudication.rationale: The handler short-circuits before the header comparison when CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset. `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is undefined/empty, the first check `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403` triggers and no credential write occurs. Therefore the described `undefined !== undefined` bypass is not reachable given the diff.
